profile.name: 串口仪器通信基类组件
profile.description: 非物理实验软件组件，用于实验自动化中通过 pyserial 管理串口连接、收发原始字节数据并检查端口状态，作为各类串口仪器驱动的通用基础类。
profile.description_en: A non-physical laboratory software component used in automation to manage serial connections via pyserial, send and receive raw byte data, and check port status. It serves as a common base class for serial instrument drivers.

registry.name: Open Standard Serial
registry.description: Serial Driver是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、打开。支持Signal, Slot, finalize等操作。
